## Files

The regions are published at stable URLs under

```
https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/
```

The same files are in the R package, in
[inst/extdata](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/tree/main/inst/extdata)
(find them with `system.file("extdata", package = "measoshapes")`), and are created by
[data-raw/export.R](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/blob/main/data-raw/export.R).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-files
#| echo: false
f <- list.files(dd, pattern = "(parquet|fgb|geojson)$")
info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(f, function(file) {
  x <- read_sf(file.path(dd, file))
  crs <- if (grepl("_ll", file)) "longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84)"
         else if (grepl("3031", file)) "polar stereographic (EPSG:3031)"
         else "polar equal area (LAEA, ≡ EPSG:6932)"
  data.frame(file = sprintf("[%s](%s/%s)", file, base_url, file),
             crs = crs,
             geometry = paste(unique(as.character(st_geometry_type(x))), collapse = ", "),
             rows = nrow(x),
             size = sprintf("%.0f kB", file.size(file.path(dd, file)) / 1024))
}))
info <- info[order(info$crs, info$file), ]
knitr::kable(info, row.names = FALSE)
```

and a QGIS style, [measo_regions06.qml](`r base_url`/measo_regions06.qml) (see [QGIS](qgis.qmd)).

Which to use:

* **Polar equal area** (`measo_regions06.*`): areas, maps of the Southern Ocean, overlays with polar data.
* **Longitude/latitude** (`measo_regions06_ll.*`): assigning regions to longitude/latitude data, web maps.
  Boundaries are straight in longitude/latitude (see [Definition](definition.qmd)).
* **EPSG:3031** (`measo_regions06_epsg_3031.*`): polar stereographic maps, e.g. Quantarctica. Not equal area.
* **GeoParquet** for data tools (R, Python, DuckDB, the browser); **FlatGeobuf** for GIS and streaming;
  **GeoJSON** for simple web maps.

## Columns

```{r}
#| label: tbl-columns
#| echo: false
x <- read_sf(file.path(dd, "measo_regions06_ll.parquet"))
x <- as.data.frame(x)[, c("name", "label", "sector", "zone", "fill")]
x$colour <- ifelse(is.na(x$fill), "",
                   sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block;width:2.5em;height:1em;background:%s"></span>', x$fill))
knitr::kable(x, row.names = FALSE, escape = FALSE)
```

* `name`: region code, sector code then zone code (T for the temperate regions).
* `label`: full name, zone then sector, e.g. "Antarctic Atlantic".
* `sector`: one of Atlantic, CentralIndian, EastIndian, WestPacific, EastPacific.
* `zone`: Antarctic, Subantarctic, Northern; empty for the T regions (outside MEASO).
* `fill`: the region's colour in the MEASO Summary for Policymakers (Figure 5), as `#RRGGBB`; empty
  for the T regions.

## Versions

The `v06` in the URL is the version of the regions. Version 06 has the boundaries of version 05, with
one row per region, labels, and the published colours; see [Definition](definition.qmd#history) and
[News](news.qmd). Version 05 is available in the R package as released (`measo_regions05`), and as the
geopackages in
[inst/extdata](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/tree/main/inst/extdata).
